mapper.insert: INSERT INTO media_asset ( type, original_filename, stored_path, public_url, mime_type, size_bytes, checksum_sha256, width, height, duration_sec, exif_stripped, webp_path, thumbnail_paths, alt_text, description, tags, copyright_holder, license_type, usage_restriction, uploaded_by, uploaded_from_ip_hash, status ) VALUES ( #{type}, #{originalFilename}, #{storedPath}, #{publicUrl}, #{mimeType}, #{sizeBytes}, #{checksumSha256}, #{width}, #{height}, #{durationSec}, #{exifStripped}, #{webpPath}, #{thumbnailPathsJson}::jsonb, #{altText}, #{description}, #{tags,typeHandler=kr.co.ircp.cms.domain.media.mapper.StringArrayTypeHandler}, #{copyrightHolder}, #{licenseType}, #{usageRestriction}, #{uploadedBy}, #{uploadedFromIpHash}, #{status} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM media_asset WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT * FROM media_asset WHERE uuid = #{uuid}::uuid AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE media_asset SET alt_text = #{altText}, description = #{description}, tags = #{tags,typeHandler=kr.co.ircp.cms.domain.media.mapper.StringArrayTypeHandler}, copyright_holder = #{copyrightHolder}, license_type = #{licenseType}, usage_restriction = #{usageRestriction}, status = #{status}, webp_path = #{webpPath}, thumbnail_paths = #{thumbnailPathsJson}::jsonb, exif_stripped = #{exifStripped}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE media_asset SET deleted_at = NOW(), status = 'DELETED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM media_asset_usage WHERE asset_id = #{assetId} AND removed_at IS NULL

SELECT ma.* FROM media_asset ma WHERE ma.deleted_at IS NULL AND ma.created_at < NOW() - (#{olderThanDays} || ' days')::interval AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM media_asset_usage u WHERE u.asset_id = ma.id AND u.removed_at IS NULL ) ORDER BY ma.created_at ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM media_asset ma WHERE ma.deleted_at IS NULL AND ma.created_at < NOW() - (#{olderThanDays} || ' days')::interval AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM media_asset_usage u WHERE u.asset_id = ma.id AND u.removed_at IS NULL )
